paragraphs: Rabbi Yonatan ben Amram, Chagigah 20a, Rabbi’s student. He would not support himself through Torah’s honor, even in a year of famine: Bava Batra 8a. See above, Rabbi Yannai. Avodah Zarah 36b, ‘Rabbi Natan ben Amram,’ is a scribal error.
